lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns across the mid-lateral surface, posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect the horizontal spot alignments, forming a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
